newsitem.title: USA: Delta Air Q3 March 31 shr profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Delta Air Q3 March 31 shr profit vs loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE - First Call mean estimate for Q3 was $2.14 per share.
In Q3 1997, Delta recorded $52 million in restructuring and other non-recurring charges related to its previously announced realignment of transatlantic operations.

In Q3 1996, Delta recorded $556 million in restructuring and other non-recurring charges related to the write-down of its Lockheed L-1011 fleet and the continuation of its Leadership 7.5 cost-reduction program.
Q3 1997, including restructuring and other non-recurring charges, fully diluted and primary earnings per common share were $2.52 and $2.47, respectively.

Excluding the charges, Delta recorded fully diluted earnings per common share after preferred stock dividend requirements of $2.88, compared with $0.80 in the March 1996 quarter. Primary earnings per common share after preferred stock dividends was $2.95 in the March 1997 quarter compared with $0.80 in the March 1996 quarter. Meanwhile, operating revenue for the March 1997 quarter increased 15 percent to $3.4 billion from $3.0 billion in the March 1996 quarter.
Full company name is Delta Air Lines Inc
